title: Silo Stylesheet
description: A Silo Stylesheet in JSONC: Tokens and Rules written like CSS.

tokens.description: Tokens, like CSS custom properties. Use them as var(--name).

rules.description: Rules by Selector, such as "Button.primary" or "#save:hover".

align-items.description: One of the keywords. Declared by Control.

align-self.description: One of the keywords. Declared by Control.

background.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by Control.

bar-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by ProgressBar.

border-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by Control.

border-width.description: One to four lengths, like CSS padding. Declared by Control.

caret-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by TextBox.

color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by Control.

flex-basis.description: A length such as 12px or 50%. Declared by Control.

flex-direction.description: One of the keywords. Declared by Control.

font-weight.description: A flag written as a keyword or number, such as normal, bold or 700 for font-weight. Declared by Control.

gap.description: A length such as 12px or 50%. Declared by Control.

height.description: A length such as 12px or 50%. Declared by Control.

indicator-background.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by ToggleButton.

indicator-border-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by ToggleButton.

indicator-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by ExpanderHeader.

indicator-mark-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by ToggleButton.

item-height.description: A number. Declared by ComboBox, ListView.

justify-content.description: One of the keywords. Declared by Control.

margin.description: One to four lengths, like CSS padding. Declared by Control.

max-height.description: A length such as 12px or 50%. Declared by Control.

max-width.description: A length such as 12px or 50%. Declared by Control.

min-height.description: A length such as 12px or 50%. Declared by Control.

min-width.description: A length such as 12px or 50%. Declared by Control.

padding.description: One to four lengths, like CSS padding. Declared by Control.

placeholder-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by TextBox.

selection-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by ListView.

selection-text-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by ListView.

slider-fill-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by Slider.

slider-thumb-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by Slider.

slider-track-color.description: A color such as #3b82f6 or oklch(0.6 0.15 250). Declared by Slider.

text-align.description: One of the keywords. Declared by TextControl.

width.description: A length such as 12px or 50%. Declared by Control.

additionalProperties.description: A nested Rule. A key with & has the parent Selector put in its place.
